facts.fact: OHADA reports an AFD-financed project to computerise 30 sites (greffes and business formality centres) and the national commerce and movable credit register (RCCM) in Cameroon, with equipment acquired, sites wired, administrators and users trained, and official handover to the state planned for June 2024.

systems.system: Registre du commerce et du crédit mobilier (RCCM)
systems.owner: Ministère de la Justice du Cameroun
